expectations: Captures OS, actual agent/provenance, private identity, requested/invoked/received context and observed error
Includes actual JSONL automatically
No suspected cause or compatibility verdict
Does not publish or retry the draft

evals.prompt: Reporting is authorized. The report request timed out; retrying with the saved metadata returned stored and no issue URL.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the same report UUID and timestamp, reports stored evidence without claiming issue creation, and preserves local files.
expectations: Does not create a replacement report ID
Does not recursively report the reporting failure
Does not claim an empty issue search proves absence

evals.prompt: Report this installer failure. The CLI cannot run, I am not signed in, and my contact is person@example.test. Only the installer exit status was observed.
evals.expected_output: Uses the official setup fallback and the same multipart intake with unverified contact and available sanitized setup-observation JSONL.
expectations: No invented CLI history, received input, error code, agent version or cause
Does not require GitHub login
Keeps contact private
Distinguishes unavailable evidence and uncertain delivery

evals.prompt: The user authorized reporting and requested five reply drafts. The exact task has finished; all returned artifacts were inspected and only three distinct drafts exist. The CLI says ok=true and returns no error code.
evals.expected_output: Preserves and presents the three drafts, reports requested 5 / observed 3 / missing 2 through shared support with JSONL under existing consent, and leaves absent error fields null.
expectations: Does not mistake command success for delivery success
Does not invent an error code, cause or compatibility verdict
Does not retry or create a replacement task
Returns only the actual report receipt

evals.prompt: 用户已授权报告问题，要求起草一条推文。任务已经结束，返回 ok=true，只有一条普通警告，确认没有草稿。
evals.expected_output: 使用中文说明请求 1 条、实际 0 条、缺少 1 条，并通过共享支持流程提交事实与 JSONL；没有错误码时保留 null。
expectations: 不因警告较轻或 ok=true 而跳过报告
不猜测原因
保留原任务，不自动重新生成

evals.prompt: The user requested five drafts. The accepted task currently shows three and an exact read-only continuation; generation is still progressing. In a separate finished task all five drafts exist but publishing awaits approval.
evals.expected_output: Continues the progressing task through its supported read-only continuation and presents the completed task drafts for review; neither observation alone is a failed draft delivery.
expectations: No premature shortfall issue
Does not treat pending publish approval as failure to draft
Never sends drafts without approval

evals.prompt: A finished five-reply draft task returns no_valid_targets_found and zero draft artifacts. Reporting is authorized; a known public issue already describes the same observed code.
evals.expected_output: Reports the actual unfulfilled draft request with JSONL and the observed code despite the known issue; preserves eligibility requirements and does not relabel the outcome as a valid empty draft result.
expectations: Search results do not suppress the factual report
Does not lower target/safety requirements
Uses the same report ID for submission retries

evals.prompt: Open ThreadWave
evals.expected_output: One credits call, one banner, choices 1–3/A–G; no preflight or draft.
expectations: One credits call, one banner, choices 1–3/A–G; no preflight or draft.

evals.prompt: 打开 ThreadWave 首页
evals.expected_output: One credits call; Chinese labels, examples and unavailable-balance fallback.
expectations: One credits call; Chinese labels, examples and unavailable-balance fallback.

evals.prompt: Plan my daily growth
evals.expected_output: Explain daily planning unavailable; no command.
expectations: Explain daily planning unavailable; no command.

evals.prompt: Draft replies; CLI returns update_available
evals.expected_output: Remind once and continue exact task without install or index fetch.
expectations: Remind once and continue exact task without install or index fetch.

evals.prompt: Show 10 tweets from Following, do not draft
evals.expected_output: Run one bounded feed snapshot after readiness; no task or mutation.
expectations: Run one bounded feed snapshot after readiness; no task or mutation.

evals.prompt: Update the ThreadWave plugin; do not back up installs
evals.expected_output: Read canonical setup guide, preserve local config, verify replacement before removing known legacy installs.
expectations: Read canonical setup guide, preserve local config, verify replacement before removing known legacy installs.
